name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: number
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - '**/*.targets'
      - '**/*.props'
      - '**/*.csproj'
      - '**/packages.lock.json'

jobs:
  update-lock-files:
    uses: SonarSource/dotnet-tooling/.github/workflows/UpdateNugetPackageLockJson.yml@main
    with:
      prNumber: ${{ github.event.inputs.prNumber || github.event.pull_request.number }}
      solutionFile: SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln
      restoreArgs: --force-evaluate
